coupon_short_description: Get All Cap Breakers for Free in NBA 2K26
coupon_description: <p>Cap Breakers are enhancements that allow players to increase their MyPlayer's attribute ratings beyond the initial limits set during build creation. These boosts contribute to unlocking animations, badges, and takeovers that require higher attribute thresholds. They are designed to respond to community feedback for ways to exceed attribute caps while maintaining balance.</p>
